title: Research Analyst
description:
About the Role

EMeRG is seeking a curious, analytical, and research-oriented Research Analyst to support healthcare and medical technology consulting engagements through evidence-based research and insight generation.

This role provides an opportunity to work across healthcare intelligence, med-tech research, and consulting projects, supporting strategic assignments for medical device and healthcare clients.

The Research Analyst will contribute to research execution, data interpretation, and insight development while building strong analytical, consulting, and communication capabilities within a collaborative and mentorship-driven environment.

Key Responsibilities

* Research & Market Intelligence Support
* Understand and support research requirements defined by project teams and senior leadership
* Conduct comprehensive literature reviews and secondary research across healthcare and med-tech domains, including:
* Medical devices
* Digital healthcare
* Therapeutic areas
* Care pathways
* Clinical and patient journeys
* Healthcare market and industry trends
* Gather, organize, and validate information from credible healthcare, clinical, commercial, and industry sources.
* Support structured market and competitive intelligence activities aligned to project objectives.
* Insight Development & Analysis
* Assimilate and categorize research findings to identify emerging trends, patterns, and strategic implications
* Work closely with mentors and project teams to interpret data and strengthen analytical outputs
* Translate research findings into meaningful business and market insight
* Support synthesis of qualitative and quantitative evidence to develop well-rounded consulting narratives
* Primary Research & Stakeholder Interaction
* Support and participate in primary research engagements with:
* Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs)
* Physicians
* Hospital stakeholders
* Medical device and healthcare industry professionals
* Assist with discussion guide preparation, stakeholder coordination, and interview logistics
* Transcribe interviews and support generation of qualitative insight from primary interactions
* Maintain high standards of research accuracy, documentation, and confidentiality
* Quantitative & Analytical Support
* Utilize quantitative findings from EMeRG’s research initiatives to support and augment qualitative insight
* Support application and interpretation of relevant analytical methodologies including:
* Conjoint Analysis
* Gabor-Granger
* Price Sensitivity Meter (PSM)
* Segmentation and pricing approaches where applicable
* Assist project teams in integrating quantitative outputs into broader strategic analyses
* Consulting Deliverables & Storytelling
* Develop structured PowerPoint presentations and consulting-style deliverables using business storytelling methodologies
* Support preparation of research reports and executive-ready presentations
* Contribute to development of insight-led deliverables including:
* Competitor profiling
* Market analysis
* Industry assessments
* Marketing strategy evaluations
* Commercial and competitive intelligence studies
* Ensure deliverables are clear, visually compelling, and aligned with EMeRG quality standards

Pay: ₹600,000.00 - ₹700,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

title: Outbound Marketing Specialist B2B Lead Generation
description:
About the Role

GUB Marketing is looking for an experienced Outbound Marketing Specialist to build and manage personalized outreach campaigns for B2B businesses.

This is not a basic “launch a campaign and leave it running” position. We need someone who understands digital marketing, customer acquisition, offers, funnels, and how to identify gaps in a prospect’s current marketing system.

You will be responsible for the complete outbound process—from researching competitors and sourcing qualified leads to writing personalized emails, managing follow-ups, and booking high-quality appointments.

Key Responsibilities

* Research our target industries, businesses, decision-makers, and competitors
* Build accurate and highly targeted B2B prospect lists
* Review each prospect’s website, advertising, offer, and sales funnel
* Identify gaps and opportunities in their current customer-acquisition process
* Write and send personalized outbound emails based on genuine research
* Create relevant outreach angles for different industries and prospects
* Manage follow-up sequences and respond to interested prospects
* Qualify prospects before booking appointments
* Book high-quality sales appointments with business owners and decision-makers
* Track outreach activity, responses, appointments, and conversion rates
* Test and improve messaging based on campaign performance
* Maintain accurate records inside our CRM and outreach systems
* Collaborate with our sales and performance marketing team

What We’re Looking For

* Prior experience in B2B outbound marketing, lead generation, or appointment setting
* A proven track record of booking qualified appointments through cold email
* A strong understanding of digital marketing, paid advertising, offers, and funnels
* Ability to research a business and identify genuine marketing or funnel gaps
* Strong written English and the ability to write concise, natural, personalized emails
* Experience reaching business owners and senior decision-makers
* Comfortable working with lead-sourcing tools, email outreach platforms, spreadsheets, and CRMs
* Strong attention to detail and ability to work toward daily and monthly targets
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of the outbound process

This Role Is Not Suitable for Someone Who

* Relies entirely on generic templates or mass email blasts
* Launches automated campaigns without monitoring or improving them
* Measures success only by the number of emails sent
* Has no understanding of digital marketing or customer-acquisition funnels

Compensation

* Competitive fixed monthly salary based on experience
* **10%–15% commission on every deal closed from the appointments you generate**
* Strong earning potential for someone who can consistently book qualified appointments
* Opportunity to grow into a senior outbound or business development position

How to Apply

Please apply with:

* A brief overview of your B2B outbound experience
* The number and type of appointments you have previously booked
* The tools you have used for lead sourcing, email outreach, and CRM management
* An example of a personalized cold email you would send to a B2B prospect
* Any results or case studies that demonstrate your performance

Applications without relevant outbound experience or a personalized response will not be considered.

Pay: ₹50,000.00 - ₹150,000.00 per month

Application Question(s):

* Explain your experience in helping a B2B business scale through personalised emails
* Write a cold email pitching yourself for this role. This will be your practical test, and the candidate with the strongest email will be hired.

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Bengaluru, Karnataka

title: Sales Manager/Business Manager
description:
Sales Closer (High Ticket B2B)

**Company:** Aquisition Monk Private Limited **Brands:** Skin Business Accelerator (SBA), Health Business Accelerator (HBA) **Location:** In-office, Incuspaze EPIP Zone, Whitefield, Bangalore **Experience:** 1 to 3 years in high ticket or B2B sales **Compensation:** [Fixed range] + [incentive structure per closed deal] **Reporting to:** Founder and CEO

**About the Company**

Aquisition Monk Private Limited builds patient acquisition and revenue systems for medical practices in India. Through Skin Business Accelerator we work with aesthetic, dermatology, hair transplant and cosmetic surgery clinics. Through Health Business Accelerator we work with orthopaedic surgeons, IVF specialists and dental practices. We have served 111 plus clinics and also build our own products, including SBA CRM and Call Coach.

We do not sell one-off ad services. We sell structured growth systems on retainer, and our buyers are doctors and clinic owners who take time to decide.

About the Role

This is not a call centre role and it is not consumer sales.

You will be speaking to plastic surgeons, dermatologists, hair transplant surgeons and clinic founders. These are intelligent, sceptical, time-poor professionals who have usually been burned by an agency before. Deals are high ticket and decision cycles run from a few days to several weeks.

Your job is to make booked calls actually happen, run a clean and professional sales conversation, help the doctor reach a clear decision either way, and follow up with discipline until they buy or clearly opt out.

This role suits someone who enjoys the process of selling, not only the moment of winning.

What You Will Own

**Area**

**Responsibility**

Show-up rate

Confirming and reminding booked prospects so calls do not no-show

Discovery

Understanding clinic stage, current patient flow, constraints and mindset

Closing

Running structured closing calls and asking for a decision clearly

Follow-up

Systematic, scheduled follow-up over days and weeks without pressure

Pipeline

Keeping CRM notes, stages and next actions accurate every single day

Reporting

Reporting numbers honestly, including the bad weeks

Relationships

Staying in good standing with prospects even when the timing is wrong

What You Need

**Must have**

- 1 to 3 years selling to businesses or professionals rather than consumers

- Comfort with high ticket conversations and multi-week decision cycles

- Working discipline with a CRM, written notes and scheduled follow-ups

- Clear spoken and written English, plus fluent Hindi

- Willingness to work inside defined SOPs and scripts

**Valuable but not mandatory**

- Experience selling to doctors, clinics, hospitals or healthcare businesses

- Experience selling agency, consulting, SaaS or other professional services

- Deal sizes above one lakh

- Understanding of how clinics and medical practices make buying decisions

**You do not need**

- Guru status, a sales certification, or aggressive closing experience

- A perfect resume

Who This Role Is Not For

- Anyone who needs quick wins to stay motivated

- Anyone who blames prospects, price or the product when a deal dies

- Anyone who prefers to work their own way instead of following a system

- Anyone who sells from memory rather than from a pipeline

- Anyone who treats follow-up as an annoyance

Hiring Process

* **Direct conversation, 30 to 45 minutes.** We talk about how you think and how you actually sell.
* **SOP alignment check.** You read a section of our sales SOP and tell us how you would work inside it.
* **Practical task, 60 to 90 minutes.** A real follow-up scenario with a hesitant surgeon.
* **Trial period or final decision.** A short paid trial with close observation, or a direct offer if your track record is strong.

We speak to fewer candidates and go deeper with each one. Expect a real conversation, not a screening call.

Success in the First 90 Days

- Show-up rate on booked calls held consistently above 80 percent

- Pipeline clean, current and trustworthy without being chased

- Follow-ups happening on schedule, not from memory

- Deep command of the offer and the five most common objections

- Close rate improving week over week

- Doctors describing the experience as professional and respectful

How to Apply

Send your CV to **shikha.agarwal.sba@gmail.com** with the subject line "Sales Closer Application".

Pay: From ₹50,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Paid sick time

Work Location: In person

**About the Role**
------------------

We are looking for an Associate to join Pixxel’s Strategy & Operations team in the CEO’s office. The team works on high-priority strategic and cross-functional initiatives, partnering closely with leadership and teams across the organisation.

This is a broad, high-ownership role spanning corporate strategy, fundraising, new business evaluation, strategic partnerships and execution of company-wide priorities.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Corporate Strategy & Market Intelligence:** Conduct market, competitor and customer analyses; evaluate new markets and use cases; and support leadership with structured strategic recommendations.

* **Fundraising & Investor Support:** Support fundraising processes through investor materials, diligence coordination, financial/business analysis and preparation of responses to investor queries.

* **New Business & Strategic Initiatives:** Evaluate and incubate new business opportunities through market validation, business cases, customer research and early-stage execution.

* **Strategic Partnerships:** Identify and assess partnerships across data, technology, distribution and go-to-market, and support partner engagement from evaluation through execution.

* **Strategy Execution & Special Projects:** Drive selected company-wide initiatives, track key milestones and dependencies, improve cross-functional processes, and support strategic programs requiring leadership visibility.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* **2-4 years of experience** in management consulting, investment banking, venture capital/private equity, corporate strategy, a high-growth startup or a similar analytical environment.

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure ambiguous problems.

* Excellent Excel, financial modelling and presentation skills.

* Strong written and verbal communication.

* Ability to work effectively across functions and with senior stakeholders.

* High ownership, attention to detail and comfort operating in a fast-moving environment.

* Interest in space technology, Earth observation and deep-tech businesses.

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, economics, business or a related field.

**Why This Role**
-----------------

The role offers broad exposure to the strategic and operating decisions involved in scaling a deep-tech company, with opportunities to work closely with Pixxel’s leadership team across strategy, fundraising, partnerships and new business creation

  
  

**About Pixxel**
----------------

Pixxel is a space data company and spacecraft manufacturer redefining Earth observation with hyperspectral imaging. The company’s first constellation of six commercial hyperspectral satellites—Fireflies—deliver imagery at 5-meter resolution and 135+ spectral bands, providing 50x richer detail than traditional Earth observation systems and unlocking insights across agriculture, climate, energy, environment, and more.

  
  

Once fully deployed, Pixxel’s constellation of 18-24 satellites will capture imagery across up to 250 bands in VNIR and SWIR ranges, with a 40 km swath and daily global revisit capability. Pixxel’s most unique strength is its full-stack approach, integrating every layer of the value chain from satellite hardware and manufacturing to AI-powered analytics.

  
  

Pixxel’s satellite constellation is complemented by Aurora, its in-house Earth Observation Studio that simplifies satellite imagery analysis and democratises remote sensing for all. Designed to make hyperspectral data more accessible, Aurora by Pixxel combines high-frequency imagery with AI-powered tools to generate actionable insights, even for users without technical backgrounds. The third pillar of Pixxel’s ecosystem is its in-house satellite manufacturing capability. Beyond building its own spacecraft, Pixxel also provides satellite systems and subsystems to other organisations. This dual capacity sets it apart in a sector where most companies focus on either payload design or data operations, but not both.

  
  

Pixxel’s team is young but deeply mission-aligned, with a culture rooted in curiosity, speed, and long-term thinking. As the company grows its constellation and expands Aurora, the focus remains on making space-based insights practical, scalable, and genuinely helpful so that the health of the planet becomes measurable and action becomes possible.

  
  

Pixxel was the only Indian startup selected for the Techstars Starburst Space Accelerator in Los Angeles and has been recognised in TIME’s Best Inventions of 2023, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Via Satellite’s Top Innovators list.

  
  

**Culture**

Pixxel is an organisation where we enable our employees to work on world-changing problems that they are passionate about, and a place where they can be their best selves day in and day out while ensuring they have fun every day.  
Central to our employee-first ethos is a commitment to ensuring that every team member feels valued and heard. We nurture a healthy and supportive work environment where we prioritise well-being and growth in all aspects of life

description:
**Additional Information**  
**Job Number**26116733

**JOB SUMMARY**

Assists the Front Office Manager in administering front office functions and supervising staff on a daily basis. Front office areas include Bell/Door Staff, Switchboard and Guest Services/Front Desk. Position directs and works with managers and employees to carry out procedures ensuring an efficient check in and check out process. Ensures guest and employee satisfaction and maximizes the financial performance of the department.

**CANDIDATE PROFILE**

**Education and Experience**

* High school diploma or GED; 2 years experience in the guest services, front desk, or related professional area.

OR

* 2-year degree from an accredited university in Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; no work experience required.

**CORE WORK ACTIVITIES**

**Maintaining Guest Services and Front Desk Goals**

* Manages day-to-day operations, ensuring the quality, standards and meeting the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.

* Develops specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish your work.

* Handles complaints, settling disputes, and resolving grievances and conflicts, or otherwise negotiating with others.

* Supervises staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs and financial objectives are met.

* Ensures that regular on-going communication is happening with employees to create awareness of business objectives and communicate expectations, recognizes performance, and produces desired results.

* Understands the impact of department’s operations on the overall property financial goals and objectives and manages to achieve or exceed goals.

**Supporting Management of Front Desk Team**

* Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound financial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.

* Encourages and building mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.

* Serving as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.

* Supervises and manages employees. Manages all day-to-day operations. Understands employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees' absence.

* Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees and ensures employees do the same within the team.

* Supervises all areas of the Front Office in the absence of the Front Office or Assistant Front Office Manager.

**Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service**

* Provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.

* Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.

* Responds to and handles guest problems and complaints.

* Sets a positive example for guest relations.

* Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.

* Observes service behaviors of employees and provides feedback to individuals.

* Interacts with customers to obtain feedback on quality of product, service levels and overall satisfaction.

* Ensures employees understand customer service expectations and parameters.

* Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.

* Emphasizes guest satisfaction during all departmental meetings and focuses on continuous improvement.

**Managing Projects and Policies**

* Implements the customer recognition/service program, communicating and ensuring the process.

* Trains staff and monitors adherence to all credit policies and procedures to reduce bad debts and rebates.

* Supervises same day selling procedures to maximize room revenue and control property occupancy.

* Supervises daily Front Desk shift operations and ensures compliance with all policies, standards and procedures.

* Ensures property policies are administered fairly and consistently, disciplinary procedures and documentation are completed according to Standard and Local Operating Procedures (SOPs and LSOPs) and support the Peer Review Process.

**Supporting Human Resource Activities**

* Supports the developmental needs of others and coaching, mentoring, or otherwise helping others to improve their knowledge or skills.

* Solicits employee feedback, utilizes an “open door” policy and reviews employee satisfaction results to identify and address employee problems or concerns.

* Brings issues concerning employee satisfaction to the attention of the department manager and Human Resources.

* Assists as needed in the interviewing and hiring of employee team members with the appropriate skills.

* Supports a departmental orientation program for employees to receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job.

* Participates in employee progressive discipline procedures.

**Additional Responsibilities**

* Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.

* Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.

* Informs and/or updates the executives, the peers and the subordinates on relevant information in a timely manner.

* Performs all duties at the Front Desk as necessary.

* Runs Front Desk shifts whenever necessary.

* Participates in departmental meetings and continually communicates a clear and consistent message regarding the Front Desk goals to produce desired results.
